title: IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER in its three kinds: INDEXED, NUMBERED and NONINDEXED
shapes: AIXA jcl/AIXADEF.jcl IDC010: DEFINE CLUSTER (NAME(PROD.AIXA.ORDER) INDEXED KEYS(8 0) ...)
AIXA jcl/AIXADEF.jcl IDC010: DEFINE CLUSTER (NAME(PROD.AIXA.SLOTS) NUMBERED ...)
AIXA jcl/AIXADEF.jcl IDC010: DEFINE CLUSTER (NAME(PROD.AIXA.LOG) NONINDEXED ...)
asserts: Three jcl_utility_cards facts with verb DEFINE of step IDC010 (step IDC020 holds the alternate index cards, H-0079), one per kind. INDEXED is a KSDS (read by AIXAKSD, ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED), NUMBERED an RRDS (AIXARRD, ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE), NONINDEXED an ESDS (AIXAESD, ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL). The kind a card names is the organization the program that reads the data set declares in its SELECT.

citations.doc: z/OS DFSMS Access Method Services Commands (z/OS 2.5.0)
Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Programming Guide (SC27-8714-03)
citations.quote: Identify VSAM RRDS files in a COBOL program by using the ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE clause. Use the RELATIVE KEY IS clause to associate each logical record with its relative record number.
